elements.label: Hand sliding an espresso cup across the table

pattern.description: Top-down live-action insert on a plain grey table: a hand slides an espresso cup toward centre frame and lets go, locked-off camera.
pattern.why_premium: A clean overhead insert with negative space and soft vignette reads like a product ad, giving the story a polished, art-directed beat that can hold a title in the empty table area.

build_hint.gsap: Not a graphics build: place the clip as a <video> layer on the HyperFrames timeline; for a synthetic version use gsap.fromTo(cupGroup, {x:-60, y:-20}, {x:0, y:0, duration:0.15, ease:'power2.out'}) with the hand and cup moving as one group.
build_hint.remotion: Use <OffthreadVideo> in a <Sequence>; for a synthetic version drive translateX/Y with spring({fps, frame, config:{damping:200}}) (no overshoot) over ~4-5 frames.

notes: Very short burst (4 frames), the tail of the slide; camera.move none, so the scale sum is the cup and hand moving. b01 is an OCR false positive ('Lo') around the hand and is not used. No SFX candidates.
